mechanism.claim: In a volatile completed BTC block, repeated crossings of the block's robust median price can have systematically larger first accepted displacements on one side. Follow the side with stronger post-crossing acceptance rather than the endpoint direction.
mechanism.side: strict sign of upward minus downward median-crossing overshoot mass
mechanism.why_distinct: Median breadth uses constituent returns; median-shift compares return halves; cumulative-VWAP recross counts crossings of an expanding volume-weighted reference; range traversal uses absolute extrema. HVMCIA fixes the completed block median level and compares the first accepted log-price overshoot after every upcross versus downcross, with no endpoint gate, volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35% while median-crossing acceptance asymmetry enters its upper 30%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily robust-level crossing-impulse onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.median_level: sample median of the 480 completed log closes
features.crossing_support: at least one upcross and one downcross
features.asymmetry_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(crossing_impulse_asymmetry) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open) minute returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: directional first-acceptance displacement across a robust completed level

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no level, crossing convention, impulse formula, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
